entities.summary: Donald Edgar "Buz" Lukens was an American politician, criminal, and sex offender. He was a Republican member of the United States House of Representatives from Ohio from 1967 to 1971, and again from 1987 to 1990. His political career ended in 1990 when he was charged with contributing to the delinquency of a minor. Six years later, he was convicted for accepting a bribe during his time in Congress.
